name: Onna Senshi Theodora ~Chijoku no Tougijou~
original_name: 女戦士テオドラ ～恥辱の闘技場～
source:
Theodora, your son is in critical condition. The doctor tell her the cruel truth, an extremely rare disease is eating away at his body. 

In front of her is the pitiful sight of her only son, Granz. Theodora, the highly respected female warrior who once saved the world, is unable to save her son.

Not all hope is lost, there is a medicine that will cure your son's illness, but the cost to prepare the ingredients is enormous. If you can get the money, then he'll be saved.

And then, Theodora was led into the arena. Thus begins a degrading fight filled with shame, malice, and lust. She does it all for the sake of her son...

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_139.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
Theodora，你的儿子情况危急。医生告诉她残酷的真相：一种极其罕见的疾病正侵蚀他的身体。

眼前是她唯一的儿子Granz那副可怜模样。备受尊敬、曾经拯救世界的女战士Theodora，却无法拯救自己的儿子。

希望并未完全消失：有一种药能治好儿子的病，可准备原料的费用极其昂贵。只要筹到钱，他就能获救。

于是，Theodora被带进竞技场。一场充满屈辱、恶意与欲望的堕落战斗就此开始。她所做的一切，都是为了儿子……

[来源：[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_139.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
